game.title: Tom Clancy's The Division
game.blurb: Online open-world shooter RPG set in Manhattan, from Massive Entertainment and Ubisoft, released 2016-03-07. RAWG average playtime: 27 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Reaching Manhattan, rescuing the wing leaders, taking down the faction leaders and uncovering what happened.

chapters.title: Base of Operations
chapters.summary: Upgrading the wings of the Base of Operations.

chapters.title: Intel and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Safe Houses, ECHO scenes, drone photos, Survival Guide pages, phone recordings, agent profiles and incident reports.

chapters.title: Skills, Gear and Crafting

chapters.title: Co-op, Challenge and Hard Missions

chapters.title: The Dark Zone
chapters.summary: Extracting items, named elites and hunting Rogue agents.

chapters.title: Underground
chapters.summary: The Underground mode: its ranks, mission objectives, audio logs and diaries.

chapters.title: Survival
chapters.summary: The Survival mode: escaping, staying warm, crafting and extracting.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Steam app 365590 ("Tom Clancy’s The Division™"). No StrategyWiki page under "Tom Clancy's The Division" or "The Division". thedivision.fandom.com answers the API under "Tom Clancy's The Division" with about 75 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 60 Steam achievements is hidden. RAWG lists "Tom Clancy's The Division - Underground" and "Tom Clancy's The Division - Survival" as separate entries, and the achievements name both modes. Two achievements ("Begin with a BANG", Tactical Operations Centre; "Tier One", an Operation with Directives) do not name Underground but sit among the Underground ones in the Steam list, so they were placed there by position.
